frozen_case: A user approves and revokes directly from the card
reason: Chat card changes from pending to allowed, then revoked and no longer exposes Revoke after the user acts.

frozen_case: The direct page explains run_active before allowing approval
reason: Active requesting Run has its own blocker copy. Deny stays actionable and Allow returns on a Shell status refresh.

frozen_case: The direct page explains run_unavailable before allowing approval
reason: Unavailable requesting Run must direct the user to request access again. A later valid response restores Allow.

frozen_case: The direct page explains chat_busy before allowing approval
reason: Busy chat is a different blocker from an active requesting Run and explains waiting for the current Run.

frozen_case: The direct page explains computer_changed before allowing approval
reason: Changed computer directs the user to reselect Work Mac. Clearing that blocker restores Allow.

frozen_case: The complete authorization reason is readable directly in the card
reason: The long request reason must remain readable and focusable with an enabled Allow action.

frozen_case: A blocked card shows the reason and approval blocker together
reason: The transcript must preserve the request reason while displaying a computer-selection blocker and enabled Deny.

frozen_case: A user denies directly from the card and can inspect the result
reason: Explicit denial leaves the reason visible and removes the Allow action, separate from revoking an active grant.

frozen_case: The card disables both actions during approval and shows an approval failure
reason: Approval mutation locks both actions while pending. A failed approval reports the error and enables both again.

frozen_case: Attaching realtime does not refetch a shell card, but a shell event updates its status
reason: Initial realtime attachment must not fetch again. Subsequent explicit Shell events update to approved and then revoked.

frozen_case: The direct page automatically removes and restores the approval blocker on shell events
reason: A direct route must unblock and then reblock an already open card as corresponding Shell events arrive.

frozen_case: A shell card retains pending content and actions while desktopShellAuthorizationChanged refreshes
reason: Keep pending card during an unresolved read triggered by the Shell subscription. Assert unchanged reason, computer and Allow, followed by Denied and no actionable Allow or Revoke.

frozen_case: A shell card retains approved content and actions while desktopShellAuthorizationChanged refreshes
reason: Approved-card hold and Revoked transition are identical to 015, which verifies the same reason, computer, buttons and final state. 012 separately verifies Shell subscription delivery into the same invalidator.

frozen_case: A shell card retains pending content and actions while computerUseHostsChanged refreshes
reason: Host-topic pending hold and Denied transition are identical to 012. 015 separately verifies Host subscription delivery into the same invalidator.

frozen_case: A shell card retains approved content and actions while computerUseHostsChanged refreshes
reason: Keep approved card during an unresolved read triggered by the Host subscription. Assert unchanged reason, computer and Revoke, followed by Revoked and no actionable Allow or Revoke.

frozen_case: A failed background read stops offering access and a later shell event recovers
reason: A completed read failure must hide the stale actionable grant; a later Shell event can recover the card as revoked.

frozen_case: A host change makes an unavailable authorization stop offering approval
reason: Host-topic read returning unavailable must remove actionable approval, separate from an unresolved read or a recoverable server failure.

frozen_case: A request update rearms its deadline and expires it without another event
reason: A request update re-arms the pending deadline. Timeout still changes the card without another event.

frozen_case: Approving a request arms the grant deadline and removes revoke when access expires
reason: Approval changes the deadline owner to the grant. Expiration removes Revoke without another event.

frozen_case: A shell event expires its grant when the timer elapses before the wall-clock deadline sample
reason: Timer delivery immediately before the sampled wall-clock deadline still expires the grant rather than leaving Revoke active.

frozen_case: A delayed approval event restores a later grant after the local request deadline elapsed
reason: A delayed approval event must restore a valid grant after a local request deadline has elapsed.

frozen_case: A request for another chat stays unavailable in this transcript
reason: Opening another chat cannot expose or act on this request despite an otherwise valid authorization URL.

frozen_case: An external URL with the same path remains an ordinary link
reason: Same-path external link remains a normal message link because of the origin guard.

frozen_case: Shell approval resumes only with an explicit callback (false)
reason: Transcript approval without an explicit callback applies the grant without resuming the chat.

frozen_case: Shell approval resumes only with an explicit callback (true)
reason: An explicit transcript callback runs once after approval and receives the selected chat target.

frozen_case: A failed Shell callback can retry without extending the grant
reason: Retry after a failed callback must reuse the already granted outcome without extending the grant.

frozen_case: The standalone Shell page honors the optional callback (false)
reason: Standalone approval without callback query grants locally and does not send a chat prompt.

frozen_case: The standalone Shell page honors the optional callback (true)
reason: Standalone approval with callback query shows Revoke and resumes the requested thread after approval.

frozen_case: Saved-password help preserves credential input and is scoped to username requests
reason: Username is a distinct native input type and positive help-gate branch. Opening and closing the guide must preserve its entered email.

frozen_case: Saved-password help preserves credential input and is scoped to password requests
reason: Password has its own masked input branch and positive help-gate clause. Opening and closing the guide must preserve the entered password.

frozen_case: Saved-password help preserves credential input and is scoped to one_time_code requests
reason: A one-time-code field uses its specialized input path and must not display saved-password guidance.

frozen_case: Saved-password help preserves credential input and is scoped to text requests
reason: An ordinary text field uses the generic control and must not advertise saved-password guidance.

frozen_case: An unlinked member finds the subscriptions in the composer's model slot
reason: The unlinked composer menu shows Auto and the two distinct plan options with their eligibility descriptions.

frozen_case: Codex opens its authorization from the composer and the slot becomes the model picker after confirmation
reason: Completing Codex authorization from composer changes the slot to Auto while preserving the existing draft and removing linking entries.

frozen_case: Linking one subscription keeps the other one connectable from the model panel
reason: A linked ChatGPT plan shows its own usage and still lets users authorize an unlinked Claude plan.

frozen_case: Manage plans in the model panel opens Models
reason: Manage plans navigates to Models, a separate route from provider authorization.

frozen_case: Claude opens its authorization from the account menu and cancelling keeps both entries
reason: Claude starts from the account menu. Closing its pending authorization restores the linking action.

frozen_case: Linked members get the model picker and no linking entry (needsReconnect=false)
reason: 007 checks the identical menu and usage navigation with the same nonempty usage window and absent subscriptionCredits. Linking is based on membership count and this row has no credit or reconnect assertion. 002 and 003 retain healthy linked coverage.

frozen_case: Linked members get the model picker and no linking entry (needsReconnect=true)
reason: Keep the reconnect-needed member in model and usage entry coverage. With a known usage window and no subscriptionCredits it shows the same ChatGPT usage region while correctly keeping the linking menu hidden.

frozen_case: The subscription linking switch keeps capability discovery available
reason: The disabled rollout switch hides linking for an unlinked member and leaves capability discovery.

frozen_case: The feature switch leaves a linked member's model panel ungrouped
reason: The disabled rollout switch keeps a linked member model picker available without plan grouping and Manage plans.

frozen_case: An unresolved subscription lookup offers no entry yet
reason: Before a subscription lookup resolves the account menu must not treat the unresolved result as an empty list.

frozen_case: The mobile Me page offers both subscriptions and opens the chosen sign-in
reason: Mobile Me offers both subscriptions and starts the selected Claude sign-in from this surface.

frozen_case: The mobile Me entry leaves once a subscription is linked
reason: Mobile Me hides the linking entry when a healthy subscription is present.

frozen_case: The shared switch also removes the mobile Me entry
reason: Mobile Me hides the linking entry when disabled by the shared switch, even without an account.

frozen_case: email subscription settings > lets a user restore email without changing brief generation, then pause the brief independently
reason: Email updates and brief generation are separately persisted toggles. The original sequence checks both directions and ensures a toggle does not implicitly change the other setting.

frozen_case: email subscription settings > keeps the previous email setting after a failed save so the user can toggle again
reason: A pending email save disables the switch; a rejected save leaves the prior checked state and a second attempt can succeed.

frozen_case: email subscription settings > explains missing email delivery
reason: Missing delivery address is a separate status from the persisted opt-in. The explanation must coexist with the checked switch.

frozen_case: Expose the full permission scope on the card itself
reason: A loaded known permission renders the connector scope and endpoint directly with a working Confirm entry.

frozen_case: Fail closed on permission load and save errors
reason: Failed initial lookup suppresses Confirm until recovered. Save failure then reports error and never sends a follow-up.

frozen_case: Hide confirmation when connector permission details are invalid
reason: Forbidden connector lookup and a successfully loaded definition without the requested endpoint show different failures, both without confirmation.

frozen_case: Reflect current connector permission decisions
reason: Active allow, denial and expired grant each change the card state; an external grant event must replace the expired state with Already allowed.

frozen_case: Permission cards keep the full operation pending and expose callback failure
reason: The mutation remains pending after grant persistence while follow-up is in flight. Follow-up failure must report update failure without a success state.

frozen_case: Review and confirm connector permissions individually
reason: Duration override, supported wildcard permission, explicit deny and gated successful follow-up preserve distinct per-card effects and grant payloads.

frozen_case: Navigating from a dismissed batch isolates the next agent's permissions and continuation
reason: Dismissing the first batch must not mutate its grants or dispatch its callback, then the second agent has independent grants and continuation.

frozen_case: Navigating from a continued batch isolates the next agent's permissions and continuation
reason: Continuing the first batch persists its grants and dispatches its callback. The second agent still has an independent fresh duration and target.

frozen_case: Policy-allowed batches show their completed state without requiring a grant
reason: Policy-allowed batch resolves complete without creating a user grant, distinct from grant-backed completion.

frozen_case: Missing connector metadata fails closed and Not now dismisses without changing permissions
reason: Missing connector metadata must fail closed and Not now dismisses without grant mutations.

frozen_case: A malformed batch URL renders an unavailable page
reason: Malformed standalone route is unavailable before a batch can be authorized.

frozen_case: A successful HTTP response without all grant acknowledgments cannot continue
reason: An HTTP success with incomplete acknowledgments cannot resume the thread; the grant response is checked before continuation.

frozen_case: A captured touch resize ends on pointerup and leaves the sidebar usable
reason: Native pointerup is the normal commit branch and the only termination handler that can apply the final pointer coordinate.

frozen_case: A captured touch resize ends on pointercancel and leaves the sidebar usable
reason: Pointercancel registers independently from release. The interrupted gesture must remove the mask, release capture and reject later movement.

frozen_case: A captured touch resize ends on lostpointercapture and leaves the sidebar usable
reason: Lost capture is a separately registered event. A gesture interrupted through capture loss must independently release the mask and leave the sidebar closable.

frozen_case: A second touch cannot move or end the active resize
reason: A second pointer must not mutate width or finish the active primary drag. Only the actual owner can clear the mask.

frozen_case: Closing the sidebar during a resize removes its blocking mask
reason: Closing an active sidebar through its own action aborts the drag and removes capture and mask before reopening.

frozen_case: Projects load and catch up on a browser without Symbol.dispose
reason: Browser without native disposal symbols must catch up two pages of project events and remain interactive.

frozen_case: An empty cached chat list discovers a newly published snapshot
reason: An empty thread cursor receives an invalidation and discovers a newly published snapshot while the project list remains available.

frozen_case: Projects remain available online when IndexedDB cannot open
reason: Database open failure occurs before transaction creation. Server snapshot still supplies a project and an interactive composer.

frozen_case: Projects remain available online when IndexedDB cannot read
reason: Readonly transaction can fail with storage open. The route still must recover from unreadable local data using the current server snapshot.

frozen_case: Projects remain available online when IndexedDB cannot write
reason: Read can succeed while the independent readwrite persistence transaction fails. A quota failure must leave the fetched project and composer usable.

frozen_case: Projects restore persisted events before an expired cursor is rebuilt
reason: A previously persisted event remains visible on restore while the cursor is checked, then HTTP 410 rebuilds from the replacement snapshot.

frozen_case: Project cache stays private when another account opens the same browser
reason: Changing identity with the same workspace must fence old cached project data before the new owner response.

frozen_case: Project cache stays private when another workspace opens the same browser
reason: Changing workspace with the same identity must fence old cached project data before the new workspace response.

frozen_case: Direct reset keeps its trust warning and uses the original generation
reason: Direct connection supplies the transport-free host-card baseline for the visible warning, generation check and removal after reset.

frozen_case: Cloudflare Access reset keeps its trust warning and uses the original generation
reason: Cloudflare Access has its own configuration-dependent availability gate before the shared reset. The protected card must show the warning and remain deletable.

frozen_case: Tailscale reset keeps its trust warning and uses the original generation
reason: A bound Tailscale host resolves the network route and normal observation branch before reaching the shared reset. That fixture differs from a rebind-required host.

frozen_case: Tailscale needs rebind reset keeps its trust warning and uses the original generation
reason: A retained host missing its Tailscale binding enters the separate needs-rebind path but preserves the learned identity and allows generation-checked reset and deletion.
